raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## What

`DotsToolParser._convert_param_value` checked `value.lower() == "null"` before looking at the schema type, so a string-typed parameter sent the literal text `null` came back as `None`, and the boolean branch mapped anything that was not `true`/`1` to `False`, so `"maybe"` or `"yes"` silently became `false`. Both rewrite the arguments the model actually produced; client-side schema validation then sees a value the model never sent (`null` is not a `string`, and a silently-false flag can flip tool behavior).

Repro (CPU, no serving needed):

```python
from vllm.tool_parsers.dots_tool_parser import DotsToolParser
p = DotsToolParser.__new__(DotsToolParser)
p._convert_param_value("null", "string")    # -> None (should be "null")
p._convert_param_value("maybe", "boolean")  # -> False (should stay "maybe")
```

## Fix

- `null` converts to `None` only when the schema admits null: a `{"type": [..., "null"]}` union, a bare `{"type": "null"}`, or `anyOf`/`oneOf`/`allOf` with a null arm. `_resolve_param_type` used to drop the null member of those unions; it now forwards them as a list so the converter can see the admission.
- Boolean conversion maps only `true`/`1` and `false`/`0`; any other text passes through unchanged so schema validation rejects it instead of silently reading `false`.
- Non-nullable scalars (`integer`, `number`, `boolean`) receiving the text `null` now keep the raw text too, consistent with how invalid numbers were already passed through.

Valid inputs are unchanged: nullable unions still turn `null` into `None`, valid booleans still convert, and numeric parsing is untouched.

## Why not a duplicate

#54678 touches the same file but fixes catastrophic regex backtracking (ReDoS) in the block/invoke patterns; it does not change value conversion. No open PR or issue covers the null/boolean coercion in this parser (searched `dots tool parser`, `dots_tool_parser`, `dots null`).

## Tests

New cases in `tests/tool_parsers/test_dots_tool_parser.py`, all red before the fix:

- `test_convert_param_value_null_only_when_schema_allows`: string keeps `"null"`, unions and bare `null` type still get `None`, non-nullable scalars keep raw text.
- `test_convert_param_value_boolean_rejects_invalid_text`: true/false/1/0 convert, `"maybe"`/`"yes"` pass through.
- `test_non_stream_xml_null_literal_and_anyof_nullable`: end-to-end through `extract_tool_calls` with `anyOf: [string, null]`.

Ran (CPU, `VLLM_TARGET_DEVICE=cpu`):

- `pytest tests/tool_parsers/test_dots_tool_parser.py`: 13 passed (3 new went red on main first)
- `pytest tests/tool_parsers/`: 1187 passed, 1 skipped, 30 xfailed; 15 errors in `test_llama3_json_tool_parser.py` reproduce identically on unmodified main (environment fixture issue, unrelated)
- `pre-commit run --files vllm/tool_parsers/dots_tool_parser.py tests/tool_parsers/test_dots_tool_parser.py`: all hooks passed

No model-affecting change beyond the argument values described above, so no eval run.

## AI assistance

This change was prepared with AI assistance (Kimi K3). I reviewed every changed line, reproduced the bug locally, and ran the test commands above with the reported results.

Adopted, with measurements. I drove both implementations over the same matrix locally (direct calls, no mocks):

| input | schema | previous ladder | `coerce_to_schema_type` |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `"null"` | `string` | `"null"` | `"null"` |
| `"null"` | `["string","null"]` | `None` | `None` |
| `"null"` | `integer` / `boolean` (non-nullable) | `"null"` | `None` |
| `"maybe"` / `"yes"` | `boolean` | passthrough | passthrough |
| `"5"` / `"5.0"` | `integer` / `number` | `5` / `5` | `5` / `5` |
| `"inf"` / `"Infinity"` | `number` | `inf` (serializes as bare `Infinity`) | `"inf"` (stays text) |

So the shared helper keeps the exact behavior this PR added (literal "null" on strings, real null only when nullable, invalid booleans passthrough) and additionally never emits non-finite floats into the arguments JSON. One deliberate delta from the review note: `"null"` on a non-nullable integer/boolean now comes back as JSON `None` via the helper's trailing `json.loads` fallback rather than the literal string; both forms are rejected by non-nullable schema validation downstream, and matching the shared helper's semantics beats the local divergence.

Pushed as 5a16b30be: `_convert_param_value` resolves the schema as before (anyOf/$defs/nullable list handling untouched) and delegates the value coercion to `coerce_to_schema_type`; the unresolvable-schema JSON fallback is kept verbatim. Tests updated: the null test now pins the string-literal contract plus the `None` mapping for non-string scalars, and a new pin covers inf/-inf/nan/Infinity staying raw text on number params. The full dots test file passes driven directly (14/14); pytest's own session cleanup segfaults in this Mac env (torch CPU `empty_host_cache` teardown, unrelated to the parser), so the pytest CI run is the authority for the suite. ruff check/format clean.

And noted on #60868: thanks for flagging, I'll take the test-file tail conflict when either of us lands second.
Dropped in 852e230aa0. Thanks for the quick look.

Did you consider calling `coerce_to_schema_type` ([utils.py#L1153](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/68ebea789a4652a6b16665d50d79805866b933ec/vllm/tool_parsers/utils.py#L1153)) here? It already keeps `"null"` unless the schema allows null, and passes `"maybe"` through for booleans. It would also fix `inf` for a `number` param, which dots currently emits as `{"x": Infinity}`. On the cases in your new tests, it only differs on `null` for a non-nullable scalar, where it returns `None`.

files.patch:
@@ -273,3 +273,78 @@ def test_streaming_emits_complete_json_before_end_marker_without_duplication(
         '{"query": "chairs"}'
     )
     assert messages[-1].tool_calls == calls
+
+
+def test_convert_param_value_null_literal_kept_for_strings(
+    parser: DotsToolParser,
+) -> None:
+    # The dots bug: a string param the model wrote as the literal text "null"
+    # must not become JSON null.
+    assert parser._convert_param_value("null", "string") == "null"
+    assert parser._convert_param_value("Null", "string") == "Null"
+    # Nullable schemas still get the real null.
+    assert parser._convert_param_value("null", ["string", "null"]) is None
+    assert parser._convert_param_value("null", "null") is None
+    # On other non-nullable scalars the shared coercer maps the text to JSON
+    # null (its trailing json.loads fallback); schema validation rejects it
+    # downstream either way.
+    assert parser._convert_param_value("null", "integer") is None
+    assert parser._convert_param_value("null", "boolean") is None
+
+
+def test_convert_param_value_number_never_emits_non_finite(
+    parser: DotsToolParser,
+) -> None:
+    # inf/nan are not valid JSON numbers; keep the raw text rather than emit
+    # `Infinity`/`NaN` into the arguments JSON.
+    assert parser._convert_param_value("inf", "number") == "inf"
+    assert parser._convert_param_value("Infinity", "number") == "Infinity"
+    assert parser._convert_param_value("-inf", "number") == "-inf"
+    assert parser._convert_param_value("nan", "number") == "nan"
+    assert parser._convert_param_value("5", "number") == 5
+    assert parser._convert_param_value("5.5", "number") == 5.5
+
+
+def test_convert_param_value_boolean_rejects_invalid_text(
+    parser: DotsToolParser,
+) -> None:
+    assert parser._convert_param_value("true", "boolean") is True
+    assert parser._convert_param_value("1", "boolean") is True
+    assert parser._convert_param_value("false", "boolean") is False
+    assert parser._convert_param_value("0", "boolean") is False
+    # Invalid boolean text must survive for schema validation, not silently
+    # read as False.
+    assert parser._convert_param_value("maybe", "boolean") == "maybe"
+    assert parser._convert_param_value("yes", "boolean") == "yes"
+
+
+def test_non_stream_xml_null_literal_and_anyof_nullable(
+    parser: DotsToolParser,
+) -> None:
+    tool = _tool(
+        "search",
+        {
+            "query": {"type": "string"},
+            "note": {"anyOf": [{"type": "string"}, {"type": "null"}]},
+            "flag": {"type": "boolean"},
+        },
+    )
+    request = _request([tool])
+    text = (
+        "<dots_function_call>"
+        '<invoke name="search">'
+        '<parameter name="query">null</parameter>'
+        '<parameter name="note">null</parameter>'
+        '<parameter name="flag">maybe</parameter>'
+        "</invoke>"
+        "</dots_function_call>"
+    )
+
+    result = parser.extract_tool_calls(text, request)
+
+    assert result.tools_called
+    assert json.loads(result.tool_calls[0].function.arguments) == {
+        "query": "null",
+        "note": None,
+        "flag": "maybe",
+    }
